mapper.insert: INSERT INTO balance_transactions (worker_id, amount, type, related_bill_id, related_attendance_record_id, related_withdrawal_id, description) VALUES (#{workerId}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{relatedBillId}, #{relatedAttendanceRecordId}, #{relatedWithdrawalId}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT bt.*, COALESCE(linked_j.title, legacy_j.title) AS job_title, COALESCE(linked_e.company_name, legacy_e.company_name) AS company_name, COALESCE(ss.location_name, linked_j.address, linked_j.location, legacy_j.address, legacy_j.location) AS location, ss.shift_date, ss.start_time, ss.end_time, COALESCE(ar.total_hours, legacy_ar.total_hours) AS total_hours, COALESCE(ar.settlement_status, legacy_ar.settlement_status) AS settlement_status FROM balance_transactions bt LEFT JOIN attendance_records ar ON bt.related_attendance_record_id = ar.id LEFT JOIN attendance_records legacy_ar ON bt.related_attendance_record_id IS NULL AND legacy_ar.id = ( SELECT ar2.id FROM attendance_records ar2 LEFT JOIN schedule_shifts ss2 ON ar2.shift_id = ss2.id WHERE COALESCE(ar2.worker_id, ss2.worker_id) = bt.worker_id AND ss2.shift_date = REGEXP_SUBSTR(bt.description, '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}') ORDER BY ar2.settlement_status = 'PAID' DESC, ar2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN schedule_shifts ss ON COALESCE(ar.shift_id, legacy_ar.shift_id) = ss.id LEFT JOIN jobs linked_j ON ar.job_id = linked_j.id LEFT JOIN jobs legacy_j ON legacy_ar.job_id = legacy_j.id LEFT JOIN enterprises linked_e ON ar.company_id = linked_e.id LEFT JOIN enterprises legacy_e ON legacy_ar.company_id = legacy_e.id WHERE bt.worker_id = #{workerId} ORDER BY COALESCE(ss.shift_date, bt.created_at) DESC, COALESCE(ss.start_time, TIME(bt.created_at)) DESC, bt.created_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM balance_transactions WHERE worker_id = #{workerId}
